description: Implementation of a service class (ReportMailingJobEmailServiceImpl) that handles sending emails with optional attachments using JavaMailSender, configured via report mailing job configurations, within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobEmailServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for handling email sending operations with report mailing configurations integration.

methods.name: sendEmailWithAttachment
methods.description: Constructs and sends an email with optional attachment, configured with SMTP details from report mailing configurations.

methods.name: getJavaMailProperties
methods.description: Creates and returns JavaMail SMTP properties based on configurations.

methods.name: getReportMailingJobConfigurationData
methods.description: Retrieves a specific configuration data object by name from a collection.

methods.name: getGmailSmtpServer
methods.description: Retrieves the Gmail SMTP server name from configurations.

methods.name: getGmailSmtpPort
methods.description: Retrieves the Gmail SMTP port number from configurations.

methods.name: getGmailSmtpUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the Gmail SMTP username from configurations.

methods.name: getGmailSmtpPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the Gmail SMTP password from configurations.
